title: One data structure under framework/ai: the old day folders move, the writer that made them is fixed

chat.text: You are right: an agent wrote the retired day folder framework/ai/2026-10-13 again today at 16:54, and framework/ai/2026-10-12 (96 MB) was never moved. An Opus task mastermind finds the code that still writes that path and blocks it, moves both folders into the store with the existing scripted mover (manifest, relink, undo proven first), writes the one-tree pattern into the AI readme and the skills, and decides whether cards and sessions share one year tree, applying it only when the dry run proves every link survives.
